extracted.name: Creamy Fruit Salad
extracted.description: This creamy fruit salad recipe, using Greek yogurt, is sweet and creamy without the added calories!
instruction_lines: Add apple to a large bowl and toss in lemon juice to keep from browning.
Add the pineapple, mandarin oranges, grapes, coconut, and marshmallows and toss to combine.
Stir in Greek yogurt, gently tossing to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours prior to serving to allow the flavors to meld together. Serve chilled.
